answersReviewFindings.finding: Blocking 1 (role_keep.go:493): every pass of the handover resolves the role's holder before anything reads the kept lane, so every POST /v1/roles/set starts a goroutine that reads the session registry even for a role nothing was kept for, and envoy-go-race is red at 5593037ddf83 with a data race in TestARoleHolderWhoseSessionCannotBeReadKeepsItsClaim/role_delivery.
answersReviewFindings.fix: Each pass now runs pause, then readKeptLaneHead, then the holder resolution, then the walk. A pass whose head read finds the lane empty returns with no resolution at all, so a claim of a role with nothing kept costs the one stream read it cost before round 3. Round 3's ordering is kept for the passes that do run: the holder is resolved after the pause. A failed head read behaves exactly as a failed holder read does, through one local `failed` helper, so the first pass of all ends the handover and a later one widens the backoff.
answersReviewFindings.test: TestAHandoverOfAnEmptyKeptLaneResolvesNoHolder - counts the session-bucket reads a resolution makes (the read role_holder.go:229 -> session/registry.go:529 that the detector caught) and requires zero for an empty lane, with a positive control over a lane that holds a copy. Fails at the pre-change code, passes here. The race lane is green: go test -race -count=1 -run 'Role|Kept|Keep' ./cmd/listener ok 202.373s, and -race -count=20 over the claim, handover, sweep and kept-copy tests ok 669.613s.

answersReviewFindings.finding: Blocking 2 (api.go:754): since the Dispatch reversal the envelope's keep field has no producer but this line, and it rides on every forwarded keep:false notice and back in every publish answer.
answersReviewFindings.fix: The field is deleted from packages/contracts/src/envelope.ts, packages/contracts/schemas/envelope.schema.json and the regenerated packages/envoy/internal/contracts/generated.go, so no forwarded copy and no publish answer can carry a keep key. The route's own request field stays for the Legion daemon's notice queue and the phase worker's stall reminder: publishHandler stamps no envelope, the role branch passes request.Keep == nil || *request.Keep to sendToRole, roleSend carries that keep, and noHolder gates on it before keepForNextHolder, which now decides only isValidRole and the lapsed-claim retention. The raw role lane always keeps.
answersReviewFindings.test: TestNoKeptRoleCopyOrPublishAnswerCarriesAKeepKey (the key's absence on a forwarded kept copy and on a publish answer) and TestAPublishWithKeepFalseToAnUnheldRoleIsRefusedAndKeepsNothing (the route's 404 with nothing stored). TestTheRoleLaneKeepsNothingForASenderThatKeepsItsOwnQueue is replaced by TestTheRoleLaneKeepsARawRolePublishForTheRolesNextHolder, the half that still holds. packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/outbox/publisher_role_keep_test.go is deleted, its whole subject being a field that no longer exists; TestADispatchRoleRoutedEventToAnUnheldRoleReachesTheNextHolder remains the behaviour test for that path.

answersReviewFindings.finding: Minor role_keep.go:624 - the sweep's lane-head read copies the walk's opening.
answersReviewFindings.fix: keptRoleCopiesLeft is deleted; one readKeptLaneHead(ctx, client, role) returns the lane's last sequence, the cursor sequence, the cursor body and store time, and whether anything is left, and the sweep, the handover's pass opening and walkKeptRole all call it; the walk takes its cursor sequence, claim and kept from that head.
answersReviewFindings.test: No new test of its own: the existing sweep, handover and walk tests all drive the one helper now, and TestTheSweepHandsOverALaneNoHandoverIsDraining and TestAHandoverOfAnEmptyKeptLaneResolvesNoHolder both fail if its 'anything left' test is wrong.

answersReviewFindings.finding: Minor role_keep.go:523 - the post-walk decision is split between roleKeepDrainAgain and the loop, and progress is tested twice.
answersReviewFindings.fix: roleKeepDrainAgain is deleted and the decision is one switch in the loop: progressed computed once and resetting idle and backoff; LaneDrained returns; DrainFailed widens the backoff and continues; LaneBusy pauses roleKeepClaimWindow; WorkLeft and HolderMoved pause 0; then the idle count.
answersReviewFindings.test: No new test: round 3's handover tests (TestAHandoverWalksPastMoreExpiredCopiesThanItsIdleWalksAllow, TestAHandoverRetriesMoreFailedWalksThanItsIdleWalksAllow, TestADrainStopsWhenTheRoleChangesHolderUnderIt, TestOneClaimHandsOverAKeptLaneLongerThanOneWalkOfIt) pin each branch of it and pass untouched, which is what 'the behaviour must not change' means here.

answersReviewFindings.finding: Minor role_keep.go:608 - the sweep logs at Info and starts work for roles with no holder, every 5 minutes on every listener.
answersReviewFindings.fix: The sweep reads the role's cached claim before it takes the guard, skips a lane whose role no session claims, and logs the find at Debug with the claim's session. sweepKeptRoleLanes's doc states why: nothing moves such a lane's cursor, so at Info with a handover started every pass would log and work the same lane for the stream's 72 hours.
answersReviewFindings.test: No new test of its own: TestTheSweepHandsOverALaneNoHandoverIsDraining covers the lane with a live holder, and the skip is the absence of work, which that test's claim-free setup would otherwise have produced.

The pod was recreated mid-round and took the unpushed work with it; the INFRA merge lane had pushed it to legion/INFRA-839-rescue at bda9b68f before replacing the pod, so the code was rebuilt from scratch in the new pod and the four prose files were taken back from that branch with jj restore --from. The lane deleted the branch at my request. Nothing of this round is lost and nothing of it is unreviewed: every file is in the pushed head.

The forward merge was required, not chosen: GitHub reported the pull request dirty at the code head efa9c9be and ran no lane on it, because the base legion/INFRA-594 moved from 3666db31 to 15e39ed3. Six files conflicted; two were resolved by taking the base whole (the base deleted the function this branch had commented in pi-envoy's envoy.ts, and stated the claude-envoy clause more precisely than this branch's edit), and four kept both sides. The fingerprint changed (8e9b0506 -> b587f008), so this head goes through the tester as a new one; the forward-merge comment names every file and why.

The merge's two consequences outside any conflict marker are the ones worth remembering: the base added a third parameter to roleSetHandler, which broke five call sites in this branch's own tests, and the base's new TestRoleSetHandlerSoftClaimPredecessorInstance builds listenerDeps with no delivery, which this branch's claim-time handover dereferenced into a nil-pointer panic. Both were found by building and running, not by reading the conflicts.

A failed holder read is retried on the backoff except the very first of a handover, which still ends it: that first read is the keep's own case, where a role nobody holds must cost one read and no walk. The boundary is the `walked` flag in handOverKeptRole.
The one-hour drop is still proven on a build whose roleKeepWindow is three seconds: the age is the stream's own store time, which no caller chooses.
